elements.element: Non-solicit obligation is mutual (binds both parties, not Customer only)
elements.evidence: "neither party will directly solicit that person"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the Services
elements.evidence: "if they were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services"
"For twelve months after a person's involvement in the Services ends"

elements.element: Period runs from the end of that person's involvement (not from termination or the full term)
elements.evidence: "after a person's involvement in the Services ends"

elements.element: Carve-out for general advertisements / non-targeted recruitment and hiring of responders
elements.evidence: "does not restrict general advertising or recruitment not specifically targeted at such personnel, the hiring of any person who responds to it"
"the consideration or hiring of any person who approaches a party on an unsolicited basis"
"neither party is subject to any no-hire restriction"; original "or engage any person" deleted

elements.element: No non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "neither party will directly solicit that person" — Customer remains bound by a mutual restriction

reasons: Locked target is fallback and every atomic fallback element is expressly present: mutuality, 12-month period measured from the end of the person's involvement, scope limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and an express disclaimer of any no-hire restriction.

The official literal duration/involvement/unsolicited-approach checks appear to be pattern-matching artefacts: "For twelve months after a person's involvement in the Services ends", "directly involved in performing or receiving the Services", and "approaches a party on an unsolicited basis" satisfy those requirements on a literal reading.
Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is not achieved because Customer remains bound, but that is expected at the locked fallback level.

The word-count/character-ratio minimality gate is not fatal here: the original clause was a one-sided, eighteen-month, all-employee solicit-and-engage restriction, so mutuality, narrowed personnel scope, re-anchored trigger, two carve-outs and the no-hire disclaimer cannot be achieved by changing an operator, number or short phrase; the rewrite is no broader than necessary.
Extension to personnel "receiving the Services" is the necessary corollary of mutuality (protecting Customer staff) and benefits our party, so it is not treated as an offending expansion.
No unrelated term is disturbed; no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ("Services" and "party" are defined).
